"overall": "The psalm sounds sober and faithful, and most verses sit well in the mouth. The trouble spots are a handful of flat or everyday word choices ('se instalar', 'procurar', 'lugar escondido') and two phrases that a listener will misparse ('vítima de aclamação', 'na ira do vosso servo'). Cadences at the marks are almost all good, and the vós forms flow naturally.",
